verdict: Yes, if you can run tight operations. The Bear House pitched stylish, affordable menswear on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Affordable menswear is a large market, but margins are thin, so you need strong sourcing and a high share of repeat buyers.
angle: Young men in tier-2 and tier-3 cities buy shirts and trousers online for work and weekends. Low prices need efficient sourcing from clusters and fewer returns. Growth comes from building a loyal base, not from constant discounting.
